content: OWASP ASVS 5.0 V2 applies: document validation rules and business-logic limits (V2.1), use positive validation and check related values consistently (V2.2), and make business-logic operations atomic (V2.3.3). Authentication, session management, access control, cryptography, web output, file handling, and deserialization controls do not apply to this in-process registration-only phase.
